name: 2MASX J13275493-3132187 (Hubble)
blurb: 2MASX J13275493-3132187, a massive galaxy in the Shapley Supercluster, seen by Hubble.
label: 2masxj132754933132187-hubble
story: A massive galaxy in the Shapley Supercluster. Hubble took a long look here to measure how fast it falls through the supercluster, and found thousands of globular clusters swarming around it.

claims.text: J13275493-3132187 is one of the galaxies imaged by HST program 10429
The program 10429 images were taken to measure the galaxies' distances and infall velocities within the Shapley Supercluster
The sample galaxies are massive brightest cluster galaxies in rich clusters
Thousands of globular clusters were found around it in the deep Hubble images
